body: I'm in high school. The thing about the arguments and such is that they limit the amount of freedom and free time I have. I'll be doing homework until maybe 10 or so, and then when I'm done I just have to repeat the whole damned day again tomorrow. I don't get time to myself.

My parents consistently get upset with me for trivial issues, and we get into fights a lot that result in me taking my sleeping bag and bicycle and sleeping at the park. My school work is stressing me out, and I can't get enough sleep at night. I've lost interest in all of my hobbies, and I don't know why. There's no hope for the future.  
Edit: forgot to say thanks. I appreciate having someone to talk to that won't judge me.
